notes:
{竹|たけ} refers to bamboo, a plant with deep cultural significance in Japan.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {竹の子|たけのこ}/{筍|たけのこ}: bamboo shoot (a popular spring food)
- {竹林|ちくりん}: bamboo grove
- {竹刀|しない}: bamboo sword (used in kendo)
- {青竹|あおだけ}: green/fresh bamboo
- {竹|たけ}ざお: bamboo pole

CULTURE:
- One of the "Three Friends of Winter" ({松竹梅|しょうちくばい}) along with pine and plum, symbolizing resilience
- {松竹梅|しょうちくばい} is also used to rank quality levels (top/middle/standard) at restaurants
- {竹取|たけとり}{物語|ものがたり} (The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter) is one of Japan's oldest stories
- Used extensively in traditional crafts: baskets, fences, utensils
